sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bb(f, color):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color and 20 < n['pixels'] < 100:
            b=n['boundary']; cols=[p[1] for p in b]; rows=[p[0] for p in b]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
action(['LEFT','LEFT'])
print({c: bb(current_frame,c) for c in ('c','B','Y')})
print({k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','score','reward','state')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
